changelog: Release notes are available in-client and in official announcements.
latest_features: AutoBasehunt now uses deterministic corner checkpoints for square-spiral routing, reducing diagonal drift and missed turns
Added AutoBasehunt Strict Corner Mode and Checkpoint Radius settings so corner-turn strictness can be tuned per server
Command Manager panel now only engages after entering a world and no longer renders or captures input on the home screen
Removed RMod module and related hooks/policy entries to eliminate loading-screen overlay flicker from that feature path
Injector bundled pack install now supports mcpack extraction via staged zip and broader launcher package path detection for default pack activation
